prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a polished game environment art concept for a distinct factory prison medical clinic, a single full-room overhead 2D gameplay mockup.
Input image 1: edit target and layout/style reference, the current game clinic screenshot.
Primary request: redesign ONLY the clinic's architecture into an old Chinese industrial infirmary with its own unmistakable medical identity. Currently its heavy beige stone coping, dark masonry skirting, and thick rounded prison wall corners look identical to every other building. Replace that architectural system, not merely its colors.
Architecture: slim straight ivory painted wall tops with restrained blue-grey metal edge trim instead of chunky segmented stone caps. Warm off-white washable plaster upper wall faces, pale sage-green glazed ceramic rectangular tiles on the lower wall faces, a clean narrow dark green tile border, discrete blue-grey steel corner protectors. The north wall reads as an infirmary wall with a small ivory enamel plaque bearing a muted red medical cross and exact Chinese text “医务室”, a simple frosted-glass clinical window with a slim painted steel frame to one side, a small wall light. The south entrance has a blue-grey enamelled steel frame and two pale green half-glazed swing door leaves opened to the sides, showing the full existing central passage; the wall top and door opening remain readable from the game's camera. Light wear only around trim and corners, hygienic but old, not a luxury modern hospital. Show visible wall-face materials on north and south walls; side walls use matching straight slim caps.
INVARIANTS: keep the clinic the SAME compact size and rectangle as image 1, same orthographic slightly elevated top-down projection with horizontal east-west lines and vertical north-south lines, not isometric; retain original game-style 2D sprite people with the same identity, pose, scale and locations. Keep existing furniture identities, dimensions and positions: short preparation counter upper left, long narrow wash/disinfection counter down the left wall, ivory drawers at north centre, glass medicine cabinet upper right, one horizontal pale blue examination bed lower right, small trolley to its right, two existing planter boxes, open central aisle. Preserve pale small square floor tiles, same quiet lighting, and subdued painterly hand-drawn game rendering. Surrounding non-clinic buildings and paving remain visibly in the older prison style to demonstrate the differentiation. Crop the complete clinic larger within a landscape image, leaving a narrow rim of surrounding campus visible, without enlarging the physical room or changing furniture-to-character proportions. Crisp readable silhouettes and surfaces, restrained texture, hand-painted illustration matching the screenshot, not photoreal or 3D render.
Avoid: no HUD, alerts, interaction popups, floating character name labels, inventory panels, measurements, arrows, callouts, decorative concept-sheet borders or watermark. No extra beds, extra characters, bright neon, tiled top surface of walls pretending to be floors, chunky stone coping, tall facade hiding the furniture, invented expanded floor area. This is one cohesive concept image showing the finished new architecture in gameplay view.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: the new clinic architectural concept; edit target.
Input image 2: the unchanged campus screenshot; reference for the neighbouring building ONLY.
Make one correction to image 1: restore EVERY portion of the non-clinic neighbouring building at the far LEFT of the image to its original beige stone-capped prison architecture from image 2. In particular the lower-left facade must have aged beige cement wall face and dark grey masonry skirting, NOT green ceramic tile skirting, and its corners/coping must be warm stone without blue steel trim. This neighbouring building must contrast with the new medical architecture.
Preserve the clinic in the CENTRE of image 1 EXACTLY: slim blue-grey metal trimmed straight ivory coping, off-white plaster, sage-green ceramic tile wall skirt, frosted window, medical plaque reading “医务室”, small wall light, open green steel swing doors; preserve every item, both characters, furniture scale and position, floor grid, compact room proportions, campus paving, lighting, framing and hand-painted game style. Change only the neighbouring building portions at far left; do not change the clinic or invent props. No UI or labels beyond the existing medical plaque.
